thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Customer HeliosMed (dedicated us-west-2 pool) reports missing traces and reduced per-tenant metrics granularity — p95 surge detected. Auto-created incident thread.

mariam (oncall): Acknowledged. Paging SREs and runtime. Are logs available for the tenant?

aj (ops): seeing application logs still coming in, but traces are absent for HeliosMed for ~00:45. Metrics aggregate for the pool have p95 spikes but per-tenant breakdown shows a null partition. Suspect forwarder mapping or lease expiry. :eyes:

jason (runtime): I can reproduce on the forwarder control plane: shard assignment for tenant heliosmed shows status "DETACHED" on two replicas. Getting lease renew errors: `lease refresh failed: 401 token expired` in forwarder logs. Pasting snippet:

```

2026-03-15T12:02:11Z forwarder[replica-3] ERROR lease: refresh failed tenant=heliosmed token_expired
2026-03-15T12:02:11Z forwarder[replica-3] WARN shard: moving to DETACHED tenant=heliosmed shard=shard-54
2026-03-15T12:03:02Z router INFO route: fallback to shared-traces tenant=heliosmed reason=detached
```

aj (ops): that matches. We just rotated a KMS key for the dedicated pool yesterday and the forwarder token-provisioner didn't update TTL for some tenants. Looks like lease TTL defaulted to 0 for newly minted tokens, they expired immediately.

mariam (oncall): Impact check: are logs searchable? embeddings/metrics? need clear customer impact statement for CS.

jason (runtime): Logs are intact and searchable via the logging index. Metrics (host-level) are present, but the per-tenant metrics ingestion pipeline uses shard keys from traces for attribution — so per-tenant p95 is missing. Timeline: gap started ~12:01 UTC when token rotation job ran.

linda (cs): I need a short statement for HeliosMed support: what do I tell them right now? Severity? ETA for mitigation?

aj (ops): Proposed mitigation path (immediate):
1) Force-restart forwarder replicas for tenant heliosmed to re-request tokens. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/forwarder-tenant-heliosmed -n dedicated-usw2`
2) If restart fails, enable router fallback-perm: `router.ctrl.force_forwarder_bypass=true` to route traces to shared-trace-collector (temporary — will lose tenant-precision until rehydrate).
3) Run span replay to rehydrate traces for the missing window after tokens are renewed: `./tools/span_replay --tenant heliosmed --from 2026-03-15T12:00:00Z --to 2026-03-15T12:50:00Z`

jason (runtime): I'm patching provisioner to set TTL=24h for newly issued forwarder tokens. Pushing hotfix to staging now, will promote after smoke. If approved, rolling to prod in ~15m.

eng-runtime-bot: CI build passed for forwarder-provisioner v1.2.3-hotfix. Staging canary (2 replicas) healthy.

mariam (oncall): Execute step 1 now. aj, run the restart and post status. Linda, you can tell customer: "We observed transient token provisioning issue affecting trace attributions for a subset of requests; logs and general metrics remain available. Engineers are performing a hotfix and manual restart to restore per-tenant trace attribution; we expect traces to be rehydrated within ~45-60 minutes. We'll provide updates in this thread." Keep it high-level.

aj (ops): Restarting forwarder deployment...

```

$ kubectl rollout restart deployment/forwarder-tenant-heliosmed -n dedicated-usw2
deployment.apps/forwarder-tenant-heliosmed restarted
```

aj (ops): Forwarder pods coming up. Replica 1 -> Ready, Replica 2 -> Ready, Replica 3 -> CrashLoop (OOM). Investigating oom.

jason (runtime): CrashLoop likely due to cache warmup memory spike; scaling memory for that pod by +2Gi should stabilize. Applying patch to HPA/limits now.

aj (ops): Patch applied, replica 3 restarted and is now Ready. Forwarder status: ATTACHED for shard-54 and trace flow resumed. Router shows traces being routed to tenant-specific collector.

mariam (oncall): Great. aj, kick off span_replay for the missing window and monitor rehydration progress. Post the command output.

aj (ops): Running span_replay: `./tools/span_replay --tenant heliosmed --from 2026-03-15T12:00:00Z --to 2026-03-15T12:50:00Z --concurrency 4`

```

[span_replay] 12:10:02 starting replay for tenant=heliosmed, window=50m, total_batches=120
[span_replay] 12:12:34 batch=12/120 ok
[span_replay] 12:18:02 replay complete. rehydrated ~47k spans.
```

jason (runtime): Verified traces present in the trace UI for the window. Per-tenant p95 breakdown repopulated in metrics pipeline after rehydrate.

linda (cs): Sending update to HeliosMed support. Will include ETA and note that traces are being backfilled.

mariam (oncall): Incident severity updated: SEV3 -> SEV2 while we confirm backfill integrity. Moving to monitoring mode. Handing off to weekday oncall. Tom — you are the owner for follow-up and RCA tomorrow. Key items for RCA: token provisioner TTL default bug, KMS rotation coupling, forwarder memory tuning. Link to runbook: <https://playbooks.internal/tenant-traces>.

tom (weekday-oncall): Ack, will pick up the RCA and coordinate with eng-runtime tomorrow. Please drop any logs, kube events, and the provisioner diff in the ticket.

incident-bot: Incident thread updated: status=mitigated, severity=SEV2, timeline added. Close when RCA completed. :white_check_mark:
